name: movedim
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::movedim.int(Tensor(a) self, int source, int destination) -> Tensor(a). This signature is representative only, not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract for overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and must not be narrowed to this signature. All registered signatures: aten::movedim.int(Tensor(a) self, int source, int destination) -> Tensor(a); aten::movedim.intlist(Tensor(a) self, int[] source, int[] destination) -> Tensor(a). Semantics: movedim permutes the axis order of self by moving axis source to position destination, accepting negative axes, and returns a view that aliases the input storage without copying or rounding any element. The intlist overload takes axis lists and dispatches on argument type; the empty list is the identity and rank 0/1 admit only the identity move. Tests exercise scalar axes, single- and multi-axis lists, negative axes, non-contiguous and offset inputs, the lazy conjugate bit, view write-through, backward gradients, special values, and rejection of out-of-range, duplicated, mismatched-length or non-integer axes (IndexError/RuntimeError/TypeError) plus non-Tensor input. Representative effects describe the scalar-axis overload's view alias only; overload-dependent behavior stays in pytest.
